contentPolicy: Product titles, descriptions, specifications, prices, and taxonomy are carried over from the existing catalogue data.
When a full description is missing, the existing short description is used verbatim; no product claims were added.
Unconfirmed source values remain null; empty arrays mean there are no source records for that field.
145 image files have no matching product record and are isolated under media/unlinked-products.
Category and subcategory names/slugs are preserved from the catalogue and represented through a parent-linked canonical taxonomy.
No product was reclassified; category and subcategory IDs and paths are deterministic export identifiers.
The Packaging category contains 29 standalone box products moved from Gift Sets based on their product titles/descriptions; multi-item gift hampers remain in Hampers & Gifting.

taxonomyAudit.subcategoryOrder: Alphabetical by subcategory name within each category.
taxonomyAudit.subcategoryIdentity: Category code plus subcategory slug; identical subcategory slugs in different categories remain distinct.
